mapper.select: SELECT mld.*, (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) as remaining_quantity, CASE mld.pick_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待领料' WHEN 'PICKING' THEN '领料中' WHEN 'PICKED' THEN '已领料' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '完成' ELSE mld.pick_status END as pick_status_name, IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) as stock_quantity, CASE WHEN IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) < (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_stock_shortage, CASE WHEN IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) < (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) THEN (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) - IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) ELSE 0 END as shortage_quantity FROM mes_material_list_detail mld LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_code, SUM(stock_quantity) as stock_quantity FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY material_code) stock ON mld.material_code = stock.material_code WHERE mld.del_flag = '0' AND mld.material_list_id = #{materialListId} ORDER BY mld.create_time ASC

SELECT mld.*, (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) as remaining_quantity, CASE mld.pick_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待领料' WHEN 'PICKING' THEN '领料中' WHEN 'PICKED' THEN '已领料' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '完成' ELSE mld.pick_status END as pick_status_name, IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) as stock_quantity, CASE WHEN IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) < (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_stock_shortage, CASE WHEN IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) < (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) THEN (mld.required_quantity - mld.picked_quantity + mld.returned_quantity) - IFNULL(stock.stock_quantity, 0) ELSE 0 END as shortage_quantity FROM mes_material_list_detail mld LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_code, SUM(stock_quantity) as stock_quantity FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY material_code) stock ON mld.material_code = stock.material_code WHERE mld.del_flag = '0' AND mld.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY mld.create_time ASC

update.foreach: UPDATE mes_material_list_detail SET picked_quantity = picked_quantity + #{detail.pickedQuantity}, actual_quantity = picked_quantity - returned_quantity, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{detail.id}

UPDATE mes_material_list_detail SET returned_quantity = returned_quantity + #{detail.returnedQuantity}, actual_quantity = picked_quantity - returned_quantity, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{detail.id}
